cycles.root_cause: _looks_like_country_follow_up didn't recognize follow-up verbs ('add', 'also', 'what about') or full country names ('Germany' vs 'DE'). Follow-up queries were treated as standalone and failed.
cycles.fix_description: 1) Added follow-up verbs (add, also, include, what, about, compare) to allowed_tokens. 2) Added country name aliases from CountryResolver.COUNTRY_ALIASES to geography_tokens so full names like 'Germany' match ISO codes.
